author: bd-spin/bd-spin-20260513T202312Z-3017126
text:
Decomposed mid-claim in do-beads session 2026-05-13. The bead description assumed all 12 1.0-scope crates have a CHANGELOG.md with an [Unreleased] section to roll up. Empirical finding (subagent survey): only 5 of 12 do. The 7 missing CHANGELOGs (pkix-path, pkix-revocation, pkix-path-builder, pkix-truststore, pkix-profiles, pkix-lint, pkix-revocation-http) must be authored from scratch first.

Split into three sub-beads:
- PKIX-wlsr.7.1 (P2): Author the 7 missing CHANGELOG.md files from the workspace-level CHANGELOG.md (1726 lines, has unified per-crate history) + git log + bead memories
- PKIX-wlsr.7.2 (P2): Roll up [Unreleased] -> ## 1.0.0 in all 12 CHANGELOGs (literal PKIX-wlsr.7 scope)
- PKIX-wlsr.7.3 (P3): Workspace-level RELEASE_NOTES.md for the 1.0 announcement

Dependencies wired: .7.2 blocks on .7.1; .7.3 blocks on .7.1 + .7.2.

Heading-style decision deferred to .7.2: existing 5 CHANGELOGs use inconsistent breaking-change headings (### Changed (breaking) in pkix-chain; ### Removed (breaking) in pkix-lint-cabf; pkix-profiles-cabf has a behavior-change with no breaking heading at all). Recommendation in .7.2 description: standardize on ### Breaking.

This bead remains open as the umbrella tracker; closes when all three children close.
